question: Can a small, explicit replacement budget retain image diversity while adding calibrated boundary-state supervision?
declared_after: Development and early retrospective evaluations of unbounded boundary coverage motivated limiting changes to the image-difference acquisition list. This test is exploratory. Whole-cohort results from both earlier methods are retained.
primary: Patient-macro small-positive recall at retrospective 20% all-absence FPR against image difference, and realized small-positive and adjacent-absence yields per 80 newly annotated masks. Report both, irrespective of direction.
secondary_metrics: FPR and recall at independently calibrated cutoffs
label_roles: Use the same six selection-calibration and six independent detection-calibration patients as calibrated coverage. Retain at least 72 of the 80 proposed image-difference acquisitions before training. All fits use exactly 160 dense training masks.
scope: No new untouched test panel. The previously evaluated official ACDC cohort is used for locked retrospective evaluation.
